hypothesis: Give independent token warps separate CTAs to change scheduling of short unfused IQ4_NL reductions without changing dot products or row tiling.
corrected_baseline: Both arms include the row-tail correctness correction published as 20d4a2bce. All original gates and experiment scope remain unchanged.
dispatch_capture_addendum_before_timing: Nsight truncates test stdout on both arms despite zero child exits. Preserve those failed text-capture attempts. Require the complete separate 100-case correctness checks, explicit profiled-child exit codes, no reported failures, and exact kernel counts/geometry in the trace; also trace the matched baseline.
scope: sm_121, unfused routed IQ4_NL, existing multi-token MMVQ path (2-8 tokens), no shared expert
distinct_from_row4: No four-row tile or type-subset revision of that failed candidate; this changes token-to-CTA mapping while retaining two-row tiles.
provenance: Independent implementation using existing local MIT-licensed MMVQ arithmetic. The survey suggested one-warp CTAs as an idea; no AGPL implementation was consulted or copied.

correctness.new_boundary_shapes: IQ4_NL, 512 experts, 10 selected, offset IDs, m127/128/129, k256, n1 through 9, both RHS layouts, mixed routes including the last expert
correctness.required: Both arms pass all cases; trace proves 32-thread CTAs and token grid Z for unfused work while fused work keeps the original geometry.

operators.changed_cases: Actual down shape m2560/k640 at n2/3/4/8, plus fresh m3072/k512/n4, each with seeded shuffled, concentrated and mixed routing

actual_mtp_if_operator_screen_passes.reason_for_gate: Fresh lower gate for a narrowly scoped kernel affecting only part of decode, not a retrospective reinterpretation of prior experiments.

stop: Reject or park this implementation at a failed gate, without warp-count, row-count or type sweeps. Continue with a different roadmap hypothesis.
promotion: Only after performance confirmation, English task-quality and release-stack validation. No installed binary changes during screening.
